nodes.label: Vite Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures Vite dev server proxy to route /api requests to localhost:8000, avoiding CORS issues during development.

nodes.label: Router BeforeEach Guard
nodes.rationale: Redirects unauthenticated users from protected routes to /admin/login and authenticated users away from the login page.

nodes.label: Admin Login View
nodes.rationale: Uses simple bearer token authentication stored in localStorage for admin access control.

nodes.label: Admin Article Edit View
nodes.rationale: Uses editorKey counter to force TipTapEditor component remount when loading existing article content.

nodes.label: FastAPI App
nodes.rationale: Application root that registers routers, CORS middleware, and seeds default admin on startup.

nodes.label: on_startup event handler
nodes.rationale: Initializes database tables and seeds default admin user on application startup.

nodes.label: Settings configuration class
nodes.rationale: Centralizes all application configuration including database URL, admin token, and external API keys using pydantic-settings with .env support.

nodes.label: require_admin dependency
nodes.rationale: Simple bearer token authentication for admin endpoints. Intended as a lightweight auth mechanism for MVP.

nodes.label: NewsletterSend model
nodes.rationale: Junction table tracking which subscribers received which article newsletters, with sent_at timestamp.

nodes.label: Article model
nodes.rationale: Blog article model using JSON column for flexible block-editor content storage. Slug is indexed for URL-friendly lookups.

nodes.label: Subscriber model
nodes.rationale: Implements double-opt-in subscription flow with confirmation_token and status lifecycle (pending/active/unsubscribed).

nodes.label: session fixture
nodes.rationale: Provides an in-memory SQLite database session for each test, using StaticPool for thread safety.

nodes.label: client fixture
nodes.rationale: Uses FastAPI dependency override pattern to inject test SQLite sessions into the application, enabling integration tests without PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Laboratory Aesthetic
nodes.author: Alex Rivera
nodes.rationale: Interface should scream science and precision. Extreme minimalism, clean backgrounds, and thin borders. Monospace typography for metadata and dates, contrasting with a highly legible sans-serif font for the main content.

nodes.label: Triple-Coded Accessibility
nodes.author: Alex Rivera
nodes.rationale: For UI states (subscription errors, success messages, etc.), cannot rely on color alone. Apply triple coding (color, icon, and pattern) so it's 100% color-blind friendly.

nodes.label: Distraction-Free WYSIWYG Editor
nodes.author: Alex Rivera
nodes.rationale: Completely distraction-free WYSIWYG editor in the admin panel. Just the strictly essential formatting tools.

nodes.label: Newsletter Capture
nodes.author: Alex Rivera
nodes.rationale: Something very subtle but effective at the end of the articles to capture emails. Absolutely no invasive pop-ups.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
nodes.rationale: Test-Driven Development is strictly required. Write tests before logic: pytest + FastAPI TestClient for backend; Vitest + @vue/test-utils for frontend.

nodes.label: SQLModel Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: SQLModel classes are the single source of truth for both database tables and API validation.

nodes.label: Tech Stack Definition
nodes.rationale: Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLModel, PostgreSQL. Frontend: Vue.js 3 (Composition API), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Vitest. Infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx (Reverse Proxy/API Gateway).

nodes.label: Design System & UI Conventions
nodes.rationale: Aesthetic: Minimalist, scientific, and laboratory-like. Visuals: Clean backgrounds (white/light gray), thin and precise borders. Typography: Monospace fonts for technical data/metadata; highly legible sans-serif for reading. Colors: High-contrast but sober palette for UI states. No excessive shadows or gradients.

nodes.label: TipTap JSON Content Storage
nodes.rationale: Store article content as TipTap JSON document (text column), render HTML on-the-fly for public view and newsletters. Source of truth for both web and email rendering. TipTap is headless, giving full control over the lab aesthetic. Adding a cached HTML column later is trivial if needed.

nodes.label: Resend Synchronous Email Delivery
nodes.rationale: Use Resend API with synchronous calls from the publish endpoint. Resend has a modern Python SDK and generous free tier. Synchronous delivery avoids adding Redis/Celery infrastructure for MVP scale (< 1,000 subscribers). If scale exceeds this, adding a background queue later requires no schema changes.

nodes.label: Bearer Token Authentication
nodes.rationale: Protect admin routes with a single ADMIN_API_TOKEN env variable checked via FastAPI dependency. Zero login UI, zero session storage, trivial to rotate. The User table exists from day one to avoid a painful migration when real auth is added later.

nodes.label: Double Opt-in and Soft Unsubscribe
nodes.rationale: pending -> active via confirmation email link. Unsubscribe sets unsubscribed status (soft delete). Double opt-in keeps list quality high and avoids spam complaints that hurt Resend deliverability. Soft unsubscribe preserves history and is legally required in most jurisdictions.

nodes.label: Human-Readable Slugs
nodes.rationale: URLs use /<slug> format derived from title with uniqueness constraint and -N collision suffix. Standard blog behavior, SEO-friendly, and expected by readers.

nodes.label: External URLs Only for Images
nodes.rationale: TipTap image node accepts external URLs only. No upload endpoint in MVP. Keeps MVP lean while still allowing rich articles. Upload can be added later without schema changes since src just changes from external to internal URL.
